description: AC-062-05 whitelist configuration (scripts/product/persistence_scan.py check 6). Besides the Persistence module (crates/hoh-core/src/persistence/) and the members' Rust sources (checked by clippy and the literal rules), only the files listed here, and Markdown under docs/ and reports/, may mention SQLite or hold a SQL write statement. Each entry says why; an entry that no longer needs to be here is itself a hit. read_as_data (CR-019) lists the JSON or Markdown files a member's literal may name although they mention SQLite: read as data, each with its reason, none holding a SQL write. append_only_allow (docs/adr/ADR-029.md decision 6, check 7) lists, by file, function and statement, the only places a member's Rust source may change or remove a row of acceptance_results or evidence, each with its reason; anywhere else such a write is a hit, and an entry without a reason or no longer used is itself a hit.
